summary: Backend-only testing for Katey Elinam Portfolio API. Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 10 tests across 7 endpoint groups). All 10 tests PASSED on the external preview URL.

minor.issue: Multi-turn memory is implemented by replaying recent history as a text blob into a fresh LlmChat session each call. Works, but is token-inefficient and could degrade as history grows. Consider native session caching.
Returns delivered=false when RESEND_API_KEY is empty (expected). No retry or queue if Resend fails later — add once key is provided.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~430 lines; still manageable but consider splitting routes (chat/ai/contact/cv) into separate modules if more features land.
CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True — Starlette will silently disable credentials. If credentials aren't needed, this is fine; otherwise set explicit origins.
EmailStr validation works (422 returned for bad email), but consider also stripping/lowercasing emails before persisting.
chat endpoint loads up to 100 prior messages then slices last 10 — fine, but consider indexing chat_messages on session_id+ts for performance at scale.
Resend block uses asyncio.to_thread which is correct; ensure SENDER_EMAIL is a verified domain once Resend key is configured.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_-prefixed contact_messages docs during tests; cleaned up after run. 6 chat_messages persisted from chat tests (left in place, harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. Tests cover /api/health, /api/cv, /api/chat (single + multi-turn with session_id), /api/polish, /api/summarize, /api/contact (valid + invalid email), and CORS (preflight + actual POST). Resend is intentionally disabled (RESEND_API_KEY empty), so delivered must be false. MongoDB persistence verified for contact_messages and chat_messages collections.

verification_details.chat_single: Reply references React/Next.js/TypeScript from CV (no hallucination) ✓
